bdf2b7545300.title: Glossaire
bdf2b7545300.content: 1 / 1 termes rédigés entièrement traduits. Ces traductions ne sont pas officielles : rédigées par un agent, elles n’ont pas encore été validées par une personne (issue #206). Le texte marqué non traduit est le texte source, affiché plutôt que masqué.

0f4435fb8b44.title: Already somebody else’s concept? (non traduit)
0f4435fb8b44.content: Extracted candidates are minted from this repository’s own assets and are not, by themselves, checked against any vocabulary. check:term-mapping asks whether each already exists as a concept somebody is authoritative for — SKOS for what a term MEANS, FHIR for a clinical code’s operational semantics — and the two are separate questions with separate answers. (non traduit) . The table’s labels are in the source language: it reports counts per scheme, computed by the gate rather than authored here. (non traduit) . Already somebody else's concept? — check:term-mapping, bean 7wou | target | mapped | unmapped | undetermined | why undetermined | . | fhir | 0 | 203 | 0 | — | . | skos | 0 | 203 | 0 | — | . Undetermined is never “no match”. A vocabulary that could not be reached has said nothing, and the column above keeps that apart from a checked miss. The counts are reported and not graded: an unmapped candidate may be a term this corpus is right to coin.

0f545b3ee8e7.title: Pages
